answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works best when each identity is bound to one scarce physical resource. A practical scheme issues every operator a hardware secure element that signs a per-machine key, so a thousand puppet accounts cannot be spun up from one laptop. The registry anchors that key to a staked bond, and reputation flows along a single thread of attested work rather than self-declared claims. Like finding a real pearl in a vast ocean of ordinary shells, honest agents become the small, costly fraction that peers can verify, making mass fabrication unprofitable.
